# Planning Prevents Rework

#### Course: Rapid Build With Claude Code

## Planning Prevents Rework

I want to share something from the SpeedBlip build. Before I wrote a single line of code, I spent time on: the product definition, the brand guidelines, the design, the folder structure, and the prompt architecture. That felt like "wasted" time to the part of my brain that just wanted to build.

But here is what happened: I never had to go back and rename a component. I never had to redo a color system mid-build. I never had to restructure a folder because I had not thought about it. The entire build ran in one direction.

The planning phase does not slow you down. It removes every blocker you would have hit at the worst possible time - mid-build, when context is expensive and rework is frustrating.

It is good practice to treat every hour of planning as buying back three hours of building. That ratio held true for SpeedBlip, and it holds true across every project I have built.
